name: Hallowed Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, the Hallowed Tablet calls young Darkspear priests to Ken'jai. Its words begin their lessons in communing with the spirits.

sections.title: A Summons from the Spirits
sections.body: Gornek gives the Hallowed Tablet to a promising troll priest taking their first steps through the Valley of Trials. The words carry a personal invitation from Ken'jai, the priest trainer outside the Den. Ken'jai reads signs and hears the spirits' whispers, sensing when young Darkspear with spiritual potential arrive in Durotar. The tablet tells the initiate to read its message and seek Ken'jai's guidance in channeling spiritual authority.

faq.answer: Gornek gives novice troll priests an inscribed stone tablet in the Valley of Trials. Its message directs them to Ken'jai, their priest trainer.
Ken'jai sent the tablet through Gornek. The spirits foretold a new acolyte's arrival, prompting Ken'jai, the priest trainer outside the Den, to send word.

faq.q: Why do troll priests need to see Ken'jai?
faq.answer: Darkspear priests commune with and command the spirits. Ken'jai guides initiates as their spiritual connection deepens, helping ensure the spirits favor teaching them stronger abilities.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, priesthood means close communion with the spirits and loa. The tablet invites you into those ancestral spiritual traditions.
The tablet begins your formal priest training in Durotar and establishes your bond with Ken'jai, your mentor.
